_comment: Authoritative source of truth for every tunable numeric threshold this LIVE account's trigger prompts reference. This is a separate file from the paper account's own risk_config.json (separate repo, separate account, separate values by design -- e.g. this account's single-position cap is 15%, not the paper account's 7%, re-derived for a $1,500 account vs $100,000). SCHEDULE.md's prose explains WHY each value is set where it is; every threshold in that prose is written as a `{group.key}` placeholder token matching this file's structure, not a literal number -- a firing resolves each token against the matching key here at read time. Change a value here (plus a HISTORY.md entry explaining why) rather than editing any live trigger prompt; every trigger reads this file fresh each firing, so a single commit here takes effect everywhere without touching the 7 trigger prompts. Values here should generally only diverge from the paper account's after a change has been tested there first -- see the account owner's own stated intent.

position_limits._comment: Rules You Must Always Follow. Single-position cap raised to 15% (from paper's 7%) and position count cap lowered to 10 (from paper's 22) -- re-derived for this account's much smaller size, see 'What's different from the paper account, and why' in SCHEDULE.md.

order_execution._comment: Rules You Must Always Follow / Duplicate-Order Guard

stop_loss._comment: Rules You Must Always Follow / Stop-Loss Confirmation

take_profit._comment: Rules You Must Always Follow / Take-Profit Trailing Stop

capital_preservation._comment: Capital Preservation Halt -- no equivalent on the paper account. starting_capital_usd is the account's actual deposited capital once funded; halt_threshold_pct is the fraction of that capital at or below which all new positions are blocked.

decision_framework._comment: Decision Framework. This account has always run qualifying_mode 'unanimous' -- it launched after the paper account's relaxed-then-reverted 3-of-4 experiment, so relaxed_of_n has no history here; kept only for schema parity with the paper account's config, unused while qualifying_mode is 'unanimous'.

portfolio_rebalancing._comment: Portfolio Rebalancing (Trade Evaluation firings only). Trim trigger/target re-derived from the 15% single-position cap (paper's are derived from its 7% cap). Dust floor lowered to $5 (from paper's $25), proportional to this account's smaller size.

liquidity_screen._comment: Liquidity Screen (new positions, Trade Evaluation firings only). Dust floor lowered to $5 (from paper's $25).

cash_utilization._comment: Cash Utilization (Trade Evaluation firings only). Dust floor lowered to $5 (from paper's $25).

benchmark_tracking._comment: Benchmark Tracking (Trade Evaluation and Journal firings only). No stretch-target figure on this account (paper's 15% cumulative-growth aspiration has no live-account equivalent yet) -- only the trailing-window comparison applies here.
